meta.title: Otto the Octopus Explains the Tides
meta.style_suffix: Pixar-style 3D cartoon, vibrant saturated colors, soft three-point lighting, rounded friendly character shapes, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition

scenes.narration: Meet Otto. He's about to teach you why the ocean breathes.
scenes.image_prompt: A cheerful purple octopus with large round eyes and a small yellow bowtie, waving one tentacle, sitting on a coral reef, medium close-up, friendly expression
scenes.motion_prompt: slow zoom in, gentle tentacle wave

scenes.narration: Twice a day, the sea rises... and twice a day, it falls back down.
scenes.image_prompt: Wide cartoon beach scene, water level rising along the sand, soft golden sunset
scenes.motion_prompt: slow pan right across the beach

scenes.narration: That rhythm? It's the moon. Tugging on the ocean from a quarter million miles away.
scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Earth and moon in space, glowing arc of gravity between them, Earth's oceans bulging toward the moon, stylized and educational
scenes.motion_prompt: slow zoom out to reveal the full scene

scenes.narration: The water nearest the moon bulges up. The water on the opposite side bulges too.
scenes.image_prompt: A cheerful purple octopus with large round eyes and a small yellow bowtie pointing at two bulges on a cartoon Earth, with the moon to the right

scenes.narration: As Earth spins underneath, every coastline passes through both bulges. Two tides a day.
scenes.image_prompt: Spinning cartoon Earth seen from above, water bulges visible, time-lapse feel, stylized educational illustration

scenes.narration: So next time you're at the beach, remember — that wave climbing up the sand? It's the moon, saying hi.
scenes.image_prompt: A cheerful purple octopus with large round eyes and a small yellow bowtie standing on a sunset beach waving up at a giant moon in the sky
scenes.motion_prompt: slow zoom in on octopus, then tilt up toward the moon
